transcript.text: Back in 2025 when I was in Shanghai, I remember people kept talking about what shows were on around town, like it was a whole thing that week.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And then months later I was in Wuhan for a work trip, and my coworkers were comparing notes on where they’d eaten—everyone had strong opinions.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My cousin actually went to the Eason Chan Concert back then—she said the seats were in Stand A and she only got 2 tickets, so it felt kind of lucky.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: She told me the ticket order was under the buyer name Cao Yun, and the contact phone she used was 13877949128—she was paranoid about losing the SMS.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: On that Wuhan trip, our team lunch was at Cai Lin Ji Hot Noodles, and it happened on 2025-04-08—honestly I still think about that broth.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The table was for 8 people at 14:00, and the reservation details were under John Smith with 13855667788—our admin handled it all, I just showed up.

intent.ambiguity_notes: Negative intent: user is reminiscing about past trips and third-party bookings in 2025; no request for help or action.
